data.title: 八重神子 · 廊下的油豆腐茶歇
data.description: 茶歇时换下巫女服，神子穿藤紫小纹跪坐在廊下小桌旁，夹起一块油豆腐停在碟子上方。狐耳轻轻垂着，她先吹了吹热气，再眯眼笑起来，紫眸中的调侃暂时变成纯粹满足。
data.action: 夹起油豆腐轻吹热气，眯眼露出满足笑容。
data.promptProse: Kneeling beside a low veranda table, Yae Miko cools a piece of fried tofu held in her chopsticks with a small breath. Her wisteria-purple komon kimono and cream obi sit neatly around her, pink hair beside softly drooping fox ears. The medium portrait includes the dish and table edge, with garden planting beyond the veranda. Reflected afternoon garden light illuminates her satisfied smile and steam, leaving soft contact shade beneath the dish.
